outer_patch.source: R106/R107/R109; image-derived marker and G0 assumption

inner_patch.source: R120 independent inner track; a projected image ridge

association_levels.same_eruption: Supported by retained Ma/Kozarev timing and morphology.
association_levels.same_outer_surface: Source interpretation; EUV/radio density-model height consistency is conditional.
association_levels.same_radio_EUV_local_patch: Not independently established. Radio positions are inferred from density models.
association_levels.inner_upstream_equals_outer_downstream: R120 ASSUMED uniform intervening-state transfer, not measured.

PFSS_primary_locator: Kozarev2011 retained text, Section 3.4 and Figure 4 caption
geometry_reason: A qualitative projected field overlay does not supply a local 3-D B vector, front-surface normal, common position/time and uncertainty. No numerical bound can be extracted honestly for the selected radio/EUV patch.
new_input_decision: No new acquisition: a PFSS model alone would not settle unknown upstream inflow or establish the radio-to-EUV patch. Existing records suffice for the conditional closure and identify the missing local state association.
outer_inner_constraint_transfer: Outer radio frequencies/compression and R119 slow exclusion are not assigned to the inner jump.

provenance.MEASURED: Saved AIA detector records; projected ridge positions, tangents and motion are reductions of them.
provenance.SOURCE_DERIVED: Radio frequencies and conditional splitting interpretation; regional temperature/sound-speed inputs; calibrated pointing; standoff/emission-model quantities with their shared assumptions.
provenance.MODEL_DERIVED: All reconstructed B fields, plasma-relative velocities, pressures, downstream states and family boundaries.
provenance.ASSUMED: Radio state-to-patch transfer, local planar ideal MHD, gamma, pressure/composition closure, G0 normals, assigned upstream flow and inner uniform-state transfer.
